Skills.title: Skills

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.description: A selection of projects that reflect how I think, build, and solve real problems.

meteorCloud.title: MeteorCloud
meteorCloud.description: Frontend development for a production multi-tenant ERP/CRM system used in production by a distribution company. Implemented complex data tables, role-based views, dashboards with analytics, and full CRUD workflows. Built with Next.js and TypeScript, integrating with backend services written in Go.

galoo.title: Galoo
galoo.description: Full-stack veterinary management platform with multi-tenant architecture, strict role-based access, appointment scheduling, WhatsApp reminders, and a public digital pet ID. Built with Next.js, Express, and AWS S3, backed by a 100+ automated test suite ensuring system stability and tenant data isolation.

rutaViajera.title: Ruta Viajera
rutaViajera.description: Hotel booking platform with user authentication, reservations, and interactive maps showing travel routes and nearby attractions. Developed the frontend using Next.js and integrated with an existing backend API, focusing on user experience and dynamic interfaces.

trendyTreasures.title: Trendy Treasures
trendyTreasures.description: E-commerce frontend featuring product browsing, authentication, shopping cart, and wishlist functionality. Built with Next.js and TailwindCSS, focusing on state management and responsive UI.

jyWebStudio.title: J&Y Web Studio
jyWebStudio.description: Business website created to offer landing page services for small and medium-sized companies. Integrated Stripe for payments and EmailJS for contact automation, focusing on responsive design and modern user experience.

About.title: About
About.paragraph1: I'm a frontend developer specialized in building modern, scalable web applications using React and Next.js. I have experience working on production systems including ERP/CRM platforms, booking applications, and management dashboards with role-based workflows.
About.paragraph2: I'm especially interested in the user experience side of frontend development. When building features, I focus not only on implementation but also on usability, user flows, and how interfaces can feel clear and intuitive.
About.paragraph3: I enjoy creating clean, maintainable architectures, working with backend APIs, and continuously improving the quality and reliability of the applications I build.
